value.rationale: The theorem answers a natural structural problem in open expanding dynamics: with each same-size danger encountered once per cycle, does merely changing its temporal order alter asymptotic escape? Two stages provably cannot; three stages can. A complete, strictly ordered four-class spectrum and exact class multiplicities hold universally across alphabet sizes. The exceptional defective multiplier and linear prefactor mark a real qualitative boundary rather than a parameter tweak. These exact rates are not contained in routine static-hole inequalities.
